The sealed prediction that T splits into three lines at omega fails. Owed: weighted modular-form Yukawas (eigenspaces of U at the automorphy phases). GENESIS v1.34 records the owner's ruling. [Audited by main (P-152, B1655, 2026-10-15): the residual of order 48 includes the inner automorphisms, which on the ruled branch are not moves (there the residual at omega is cyclic of order 12, B1634); the near-omega clause has no cell -- no spectrum near omega was computed -- and the near-fixed-point mechanism's input, distinct residual charges, is what Z4 found; tau = omega is retired only as 'no hierarchy found at omega' (B1640)] 0 of 19.
